title.title: Minimal models for every lc pair, and generalised abundance
title.subtitle: Claim: generalized lc pairs have minimal models or Mori fibre spaces, and $K_X+B+M$ nef is numerically semiample

plain: Every shape can be simplified step by step until it is 'minimal' or splits off a simple piece

beats.text: Generalised abundance: adding a nef moduli part $M$ does not spoil semiampleness
The proof uses two other release families as black boxes
So it stands or falls with families 034 and 056

achievement.label: Existence of minimal models; generalised abundance
achievement.context: Before: minimal models for log general type (BCHM, 2010); low-dimensional cases
achievement.note: Existence only: no claim that every MMP terminates

verify.ourCheck: We graded the claim, not whether it is right

voice.text: The minimal model program simplifies each variety to a minimal model or a fibre space.
Before, only log general type was known.
Claimed: minimal models exist, and generalised abundance holds.

sources.ref: article, Minimal models and generalised abundance (family 036)
sources.quote: The generalised abundance paper uses the release's own abundance and termination theorems as black boxes, so it stands or falls with families 034 and 056.
Lazić–Peternell formulated generalised abundance ('On generalised abundance, I', Publ. RIMS 2020) and proved low-dimensional cases
036_2 is the existence form only ('makes no assertion that every arbitrary MMP terminates')
K_X+B+M is numerically equivalent to a semiample Q-Cartier divisor
I graded what each family claims, not whether it is right.
